messages:
Priya K: Heads up — QBR playback for Northbridge is scheduled Fri 10am PT. Need slides, exec ask, and renewal-risk summary. Who can own slide deck finalization?
Jordan L: I can take the slide deck. Will drop updated deck by Thu EOD. Need the renewal risk 1-pager from CS to include impact/cost delta.
Marta S: I’ll own renewal risk + onboarding status. Pulling activation metrics now (dashboard link) and listing open blockers.
Alex R: Can we also get a 30s exec narrative + 3 backup bullets? Evan, you good to draft the talk track?
Evan M: @Alex R yep — I’ll draft the 30s narrative and 3 bullets. Need a short product update line from Eng (no deep dive).
Sam CSE: I’ll collect enablement artifacts and champion feedback snippets. Want a single slide with 2-3 champion quotes?
Priya K: :thumbsup: yes to quotes. Also request two backup ask slides (A/B — standard vs. playbook + enablement). Jordan, can you add a rollback/mitigation slide for the ask?
Jordan L: On it. Also tagging @cs-bot to create action items in Asana.
cs-bot: Created Asana task QBR-Northbridge-Deck-Finalize (owner: Jordan L) due 2026-03-26.
Marta S: Quick status note: customer activation at 65%. Two main blockers: SSO mapping and intermittent LLM throughput spikes during peak queries. Mitigations: SSO mapping sprint + temporary rate-limiter & priority routing. Will include ETA on each.
Alex R: For renewal risk framing, propose showing impact delta and recommended path: playbook + enablement discount vs. standard renewal. Priya — do we want to recommend the playbook path?
Priya K: Recommend playbook + enablement discount to preserve ARR and adoption. Capture the cost delta on slide 5 and call out projected activation lift.
Evan M: I'll have the talktrack + demo failover script by Thu morning. Preparing a 1-slide failover checklist in case latency spikes during demo.
Jordan L: Thanks everyone — uploading v3 by Thu 6pm PT. If folks want to rehearse, book the 30m slot Thu 8:30am PT (calendar invite sent).
Priya K: Booked the rehearsal. Please add final notes/links to the Asana tasks and drop one-line status in this thread when done. :rocket:
